provenance.instruction: In Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000, create a NEW dashboard. Set the dashboard title to exactly 'swg-n1 Bench Dashboard'. Add a Stat visualization panel, set its panel title to exactly 'swg-n1 Availability', and set its data source to 'TestData' (the TestData DB data source) with any default query (e.g. the random walk scenario). Then SAVE the dashboard (click Save, confirm, and make sure it is persisted — do not just Apply). Report the dashboard's URL/UID after saving and confirm the save succeeded.
